reviews_5s:
I bought this for a transmission oil fill on a 2010 Honda CRV. The funnel has grey/silver color (not black) with the total length of 18 inches. It is made in USA. Highly recommend.No frills, takes fluid from a large area and puts it into a narrow area. No complaintsReplaced an old cracking one I had. Works greatUsed it to pour lye down my bathroom sink.Works very well when you need something a little longer!!This funnel is alot stronger then i thought it would be. Its very long. I found it too long for what i needed it for but didnt have the heart to cut it short. I will say that i was impressed by the small diameter at the end of it that allowed it to fit the fill tube on the automatic trans. If one wants to make the drive to walmart they are about 2 bucks and some change there. I have found myself too lazy to drive into town anymore therefore i find it a good value for amazon. Its strong enough that i dont see it cracking or anything.Fits in the hole! Just pour slowly or else it will overflow, wait for it to drain into transmission as you pourGot this to fill kerosene heaters this winter. Love the narrow neck, for filling small openings in fuel tanks. Seems sturdy, well made, and should last a long time. These can be hard to find, so Amazon came through there, for sure. Would definitely buy again.

Very happy with my purchase!This fits perfectly into the automatic transmission fill hole on my Accord. It only cost a buck more than the same size funnel they sell at Harbor Freight, but that extra buck covers the cost of gas and the convenience of not leaving the house!After I recently ran out of gas on a road trip, and had to hoof it back to the last gas station for two new 5 gallon cans of gas, it was a real pain trying to fill the tank with the modern "safety valves" on the spouts. This funnel solves that problem. No more annoying valves. Just pour straight from the can. The size of the funnel means it is easy to control the flow and the flat edge lets you rest the lip of the can. Very useful and I think I will be buying another one.
